requirement.statement: Kunun public packages SHALL expose typed Property metadata for downstream ORM profiles and SHALL NOT expose or positively parse a detached ORM relation annotation descriptor.

case.given: the Kunun source tree and built public package artifacts
case.when: their annotation API surface is inspected
case.then: they SHALL NOT contain OrmRelationAnnotationProfile, ValidateDepaOrmRelation, or a positive detached orm relation parser

case.given: generic relation declarations, generic annotations, and typed class Properties
case.when: the Kunun packages are tested and typechecked
case.then: those language features SHALL remain available without ORM-specific interpretation in Kunun core
